EGY.note: Document states nothing on rules or authority against AI harms.
Only proposes piloting three public-finance applications; none stated under way or in service.
Names locally developed AI applications in health, justice and education without saying a public sector system uses them in service.
Minister outlined the National AI Strategy 2025-2030 but the document states no cabinet approval, body or funding.

facts.fact: ICT Minister Raafat Hindi told the Senate that Egypt has locally developed the Arabic speech-recognition and machine-translation application Belmasry and the Karnak Egyptian language model.

EGY.note: Only an aim to attract data centre investment; no facility stated.
Mentions data sovereignty only as a condition for AI pilots; no rule, hosting or contract terms stated.
Nothing on government staff running or building systems.
No data centre for hire or its owner stated.
Only a ministry target of supporting 250 startups by 2030; no law, labelling or fund stated.
No hub or technology park stated.
